feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 6 September 2026 5:34am
items.description:
##Today##

A cloudy start, with an area of heavy rain and drizzle soon clearing to leave much of the day dry, with brighter spells developing later in the morning and through the afternoon. Some further outbreaks of rain will arrive early in the evening, gradually clearing overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-8


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S 20-25, veering W 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.


##Tomorrow##

Largely cloudy with outbreaks of rain arriving late afternoon and clearing early in the night. Clear spells will then develop overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-7


##Wind Speed##

19


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 15-20, increasing 20-25 in the afternoon, occasionally 30 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Occasional hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing.


##Tuesday, 8 September 2026##

Starting dry with bright or sunny intervals, before some showery outbreaks of rain in the afternoon and evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, veering W or NW later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Wednesday, 9 September 2026##

Largely dry with some sunny intervals, then turning cloudy later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-0.5


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

NW 20-25, decreasing 5-15, then backing W or SW, then S 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first.


##Thursday, 10 September 2026##

Cloudy with some outbreaks of rain, clearing later.


##Temperature##

1-5

S
